guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster / Esquire (the 'Born to Run' guitar, a hybrid Tele/Esquire)
models: Esquire (the 'Born to Run' guitar, a hybrid Tele
guitar.evidence: Springsteen's battered Telecaster/Esquire hybrid is one of the most iconic guitars in rock, featured on countless album covers.

tone.summary: A bright, jangly rhythm tone achieved using a clean boost/overdrive into a Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a 2x12 cabinet, enhanced by chorus and subtle room reverb.
corrections: Shift from mid-gain to cleaner jangle
Keep grit light, not Tube Screamer-driven

rig.name: Bruce Springsteen - Hungry Heart - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and noise from the guitar signal.
Provide a light, chimey edge-of-breakup crunch without heavy mid-gain overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the clean boost/light grit required, avoiding the aggressive nature of Blues OD or Comp.
No heavy distortion is required; the Green OD handles the necessary grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright Fender/Vox-style tone required for jangly rock.
Provide the required bright, compact sound profile (2x12) matching Fender-style gear.
Tame the mids and enhance the high-end chime/jangly quality.
Add subtle width and movement to the rhythm tone without sounding overly processed.
Provide the requested slight room ambience without muddying the jangly tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better high-end clarity and vintage character.

proposals.reason: Enhance chime and natural room sound for jangly tone.
